newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel, Slovenia close to free trade agreement.
newsitem.headline: Israel, Slovenia close to free trade agreement.

text.p: Israel expects to sign a free trade agreement with Slovenia soon, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Thursday.
It said an accord being negotiated would exempt most Israeli industrial products from duties on terms similar to or better than those granted to Slovenia's West European trade partners.
Manufactured imports from Slovenia to Israel would also enjoy preferable terms, as would selected agricultural and processed food imports from the two countries.
Trade now amounts to several hundred million dollars a year, but the ministry said it was expected to grow substantially when the accord took effect sometime in the first half of 1997.
